package.name: cell_platform_interfaces
package.description: Platform-neutral contracts for the assembly cell: abstract motion, gripper, pose-source and scene backends; the platform config reader (every topic, frame, joint, action and service name comes from config/platforms/<platform>.yaml); the Humble/Jazzy compatibility shim; the signal-availability vocabulary. Python 3.10 and ROS 2 Humble compatible. No new ROS interfaces: every message the backends exchange is a standard one (control_msgs, sensor_msgs, vision_msgs, trajectory_msgs).
